_purpose: Composer-level view across ALL FOUR Dasa Sahitya sources now collected: the web crawl (dge/data/DvaitaVedanta/Itara/DasaSahitya), and three local-asset imports (dge/data/dasa_sahitya_local/{dasa1,collection_padagalu,raw_dump}). Supersedes dasa1/cross_source_duplicate_review.json for the 5 composers that now appear in 3+ sources; that file's other findings (needs_human_review, web_side_likely_junk, app_composers_new_to_corpus) still stand and are not repeated here.

collection_padagalu.text_pairing: Kannada + a genuine parallel English-transliteration body text (only source with this)

raw_dump.text_pairing: Kannada only, no titles/metadata at all

five_composers_in_3_or_4_sources.note: raw_dump's 305 and web's 306 are close in count but NOT verified as the same 305/306 songs — could be identical, could be a different overlapping-but-distinct subset. Needs a text-fingerprint pass, not just a count comparison, before assuming any two of these four are redundant with each other.
same caveat — four independently-sized captures, none verified against each other at the composition level yet.
web also has a 1-item 'Vyasarajaru' spelling-variant file, already flagged in dasa1's review for merging into this same identity.

raw_dump's gopaladasa.json also carried a 1-item composer-biography record ('ಪರಿಚಯ'), imported separately with form:'note' rather than counted as a pada — worth keeping as a short bio blurb once merged, not silently dropped.

raw_dump/ugabhoga.json.composer: unknown — this file is a genre-only dump, not scoped to one dasaru
raw_dump/ugabhoga.json.note: Ugabhogas are heavily associated with Purandara Dasaru historically, but that is a prior, not evidence — do not attribute these to him without a text-fingerprint match against his other 3 sources' compositions. Left composer:'' and form:'ugabhoga' in the imported records specifically so this doesn't get silently mis-attributed.

what_this_does_not_tell_you_yet: None of these counts have been cross-checked at the individual-composition level (same fingerprint = same song appearing in 2+ sources vs 4 independently-different capture sets of the same composer's larger body of work). The existing web-crawl importer already has a fingerprint-based dedupe() (composer + first 80 Kannada chars, see tools/DvaitaVedanta/Itara/DasaSahitya/import_DvaitaVedanta/Itara/DasaSahitya.py) — running that same logic across all four sources' records for these 5 composers is the next concrete step before any merge, and is cheap to do since it's plain text comparison, no human judgment required for the composer-identity question (that part IS settled for these 5).
